metadata_input_corner.name: encoded_core_override_supported_by_validator
metadata_input_corner.description: The builder validation decoded the inherited core-properties override, but metadata lookup compared its raw URI, added a duplicate decoded override, and conservatively aborted. The original destination was preserved. OPC schema validity of this encoded URI is outside this review and was not established.

independent_pass_scope: Existing unrelated legacy temp symlinks remain untouched on success and archive-write failure.
New output receives explicit file mode and existing output survives fchmod and KeyboardInterrupt integrity failures.
Foreign regular-file, hardlink and deletion substitutions at the unique temp path cause protected abort without cleanup of a foreign replacement.
Duplicate or external core relationships are rejected; unrelated core metadata is preserved.
Visible Markdown title matches the single metadata title; table count headers explicitly identify both zones.
scope: Historical review of pre-followup builder SHA 55a7b960, using scratch packages only. Eleven tests passed and one conservative input-normalization corner was observed; later review independently resolves it. Shipping documents and scientific code were not edited or executed by this review.
